optional_integrations.scope: Exclude all optional mod cells, machines, recipes, assets, compatibility code and mixins. Forge, GTNH AE2 and MUI2 are required platform dependencies. GT machines and native AE2 pattern providers remain part of the requested test world. Native NEI presentation is a platform adaptation.

native_gregtech.scope: Implement native GT5 item/fluid boundaries and GregTech integration recipes by comparison with the 1.20.1 mainline. This does not re-enable other optional-mod cells, assets, recipes, compatibility code or mixins.

large_integrated_workstation.source: User instruction on 2026-10-25: 大型集成工作站无需注册升级卡。
large_integrated_workstation.scope: The seven integrated_working_station_module_* cards from NEItems belong to the large workstation module inventory. They are excluded from the 1.7.10 registration, UI and recipe scope. Ordinary AE2 upgrade cards for the small workstation are unaffected.
